source: Written by hand from the approved Pouch plan on 2026-10-16. Replace this file with the snapshot that the Pouch customer MCP test writes.

tools.name: joey_whoami
tools.purpose: Show the signed-in member, the workspace, the member role and the granted scopes.

tools.name: joey_list_paths
tools.purpose: List the workspace path requests that have delivered paths, with filters and a cursor.

tools.name: joey_get_path_report
tools.purpose: Read the full report of one path request: paths, hops, strength words, evidence and intro stage.

tools.name: joey_get_intro_draft
tools.purpose: Get the AI-written intro email draft for one path: to, subject, body and introducer.

tools.name: joey_get_intro_tracker
tools.purpose: Read the introduction tracker: the stage of each intro, its dates and the counters.

tools.name: joey_list_path_preferences
tools.purpose: List the saved path preferences of the member.

tools.name: joey_get_icp
tools.purpose: Read the ideal customer profile (ICP) of the workspace and its version.

tools.name: joey_list_prospects
tools.purpose: List the prospects of the workspace, saved targets included.

tools.name: joey_request_path
tools.purpose: Ask Joey to find a path to a new target person.

tools.name: joey_save_target
tools.purpose: Save the target of a path request as a high-priority prospect.

tools.name: joey_find_better_path
tools.purpose: Ask Joey for a better path to the same target, with a preference.

tools.name: joey_set_intro_stage
tools.purpose: Set the intro stage of a path request, with a short note.

tools.name: joey_stop_intro
tools.purpose: Stop an intro that will not go on, with an optional reason.

tools.name: joey_rate_familiarity
tools.purpose: Record how well the member knows a person on a path.

tools.name: joey_delete_path_preference
tools.purpose: Delete one saved path preference of the member.

tools.name: joey_update_icp
tools.purpose: Change the workspace ICP. Only for workspace admins.

prompts.name: joey_make_intro
prompts.purpose: Make the intro for one path request, for clients without skills.

prompts.name: joey_follow_up
prompts.purpose: Find the intros that need a follow-up, for clients without skills.

prompts.name: joey_weekly_review
prompts.purpose: Review the paths and intros of the week, for clients without skills.
